claims.claim: Explains Stellar's SCP and lack of protocol validator rewards.

sources.quote: The Stellar network reaches consensus using the Stellar Consensus Protocol (SCP), which is a construction of the Federated Byzantine Agreement (FBA). ... There are no monetary rewards for being a validator on the Stellar network.

claims.notes: The official page also contrasts FBA with Proof of Stake, which relies on staking power.

claims.claim: Reports no live native-XLM LST in the dated source universe.

sources.quote: As validators on Stellar, they will receive no block rewards, no staking yield, no MEV awards, and no share of transaction fees.
FBA differs from ... Proof of Stake ... by instead relying on the agreement of trusted nodes.

claims.notes: This verdict applies only to the explicit 2026-07-10 source-bounded finding. A 2026-08-30 web sweep found stst-lake.vercel.app claiming an sXLM mainnet product. Its linked GitHub repository returned 404, and the UI showed 0.00% APY. This later surface does not contradict the dated finding, but it requires future review before any current absence claim.

claims.claim: Treats issuer-funded XLM yield and lending/LP/vault positions as non-LSTs.

sources.quote: yXLM is an interest earning XLM tethered token. ... 1 yXLM is always redeemable for 1 XLM through Ultra Capital anchor.
Any eligible participant can deposit assets into a liquidity pool, and in return, receive pool shares representing their ownership of that asset.

claims.notes: The issuer record attributes yXLM to an anchor-backed tethered token. The pool guide attributes LP yield to pool participation, not validator staking.

claims.claim: Treats external ETH staking wrappers as different from native validator staking.

sources.quote: Chrysalis enables users to convert their XLM into ETH, which is then staked on Lido ... on Ethereum.

claims.notes: The current official submission page describes conversion to ETH and Ethereum staking. It does not describe native XLM validator staking.

evidenceLines: Live re-check 2026-08-30: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/learn/fundamentals/stellar-consensus-protocol — SCP remains FBA-based and validators receive no monetary rewards.
Live re-check 2026-08-30: https://stellar.org/blog/ecosystem/becoming-a-stellar-validator — Stellar validators receive no block rewards or staking yield.
Live re-check 2026-08-30: https://ultracapital.xyz/.well-known/stellar.toml — yXLM remains an Ultra Capital anchor-redeemable interest token.
Live re-check 2026-08-30: https://communityfund.stellar.org/submissions/reclPkvuD4iqLs6E5 — Chrysalis converts XLM to ETH and stakes the ETH through Lido on Ethereum.
